description: Use this when the user wants the words from an audio or video recording — a meeting, lecture, interview or voice memo — and gives a link to the file (https, up to 25 MB). Returns the transcript and saves it as a document in their Xenition workspace. To turn it into notes and action items, pass the text to meeting_notes.

language.description: optional spoken language code, e.g. 'en', 'es'; detected when omitted

title.description: optional name for the saved transcript

url.description: https link to an audio or video file (mp3, m4a, wav, mp4, webm …), up to 25 MB

name: transcribe_audio
title: Transcribe a recording
